notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional mana-producing land
description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate another mana producing land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Simic Growth Chamber and another mana-producing land.
Repeat.
